games.name: AI Quest
games.tagline: An adventure the model tells as you play
games.description: Pick a world and step into a story nobody has written yet. The model on your PS5 narrates every scene and offers three choices; your health, gold and items follow what happens. No two runs are the same.

games.name: Riddle Master
games.tagline: Ten riddles, four answers, one clever model
games.description: The model writes a fresh riddle and four possible answers. Pick the right one before your streak breaks. Choose easy, tricky or fiendish.

games.name: Block Drop
games.description: The classic falling-block puzzle. Rotate and slide pieces to complete lines. Clear several at once for more points; the pace picks up every ten lines.

games.name: Neon Snake
games.description: Guide the snake to the food and grow longer with every bite. Walls are fatal, and so is your own tail. It gets faster as you grow.

games.name: Brick Breaker
games.tagline: Bounce the ball, smash the wall
games.description: Keep the ball in play with your paddle and break every brick. Three lives, more levels, and the ball speeds up as you go.
Slide the tiles; two of the same number merge into one. Keep merging to reach the 2048 tile, then keep going for a high score.

games.name: Minesweeper
games.tagline: Clear the field, flag the mines
games.description: Open squares without hitting a mine. Each number tells you how many mines touch that square. Flag the mines and clear the rest as fast as you can.

games.name: Memory Match
games.tagline: Find every pair in as few turns as you can
games.description: Turn over two cards at a time and find the matching pairs. Fewer turns means a better score.
